The Journal of Reluctant Greatness

SHARVIL

A modest young man burdened with the knowledge that everyone else is several leagues beneath him.

High School Edition Excellence, peer-reviewed Price: more than you can afford
Profile in insufficient achievement

The Crushing Weight of Being Merely Better Than Everyone

Sharvil does not consider himself exceptional. Exceptional is a word used by ordinary people when they briefly glimpse competence. He simply wakes up, surveys the peasants below, and wonders why he has accomplished so little.

His research paper has been cited only three times. Three. While still in high school. Some would frame this as absurdly impressive; Sharvil frames it as a humiliating reminder that the fourth citation remains unwritten.

Athletics

A Fair Fight Would Require Several More Opponents

Strength, speed, strategy: Sharvil excels at all three, then criticizes his footwork. His rivals call it domination. He calls it an unfocused warm-up and makes a note to train harder tomorrow.

Self-assessment

The Agony of Near-Perfection

Every triumph is merely proof that the goal was set too low. Sharvil reserves his most dramatic anguish for achievements that would become somebody else's entire personality.

Rest & performance

Yes, He Is Better at Sleeping Too

Sleep is not inactivity. In Sharvil's hands—or eyelids—it is a disciplined program of neurological maintenance. His form is economical, his breathing peerless, and his dreams almost certainly better sourced than your bibliography.

Upon waking, he awards the performance a six out of ten. Too much time spent resting, not enough time spent advancing human knowledge. Nearby peasants, exhausted from trying to keep pace, remain asleep.

“I am nowhere near where I should be. Fortunately, everyone else is much farther away.” — Sharvil, probably
Nutrition

Even Lunch Has Standards

Others eat. Sharvil refuels. Every bite is nonchalant, optimized, and taken without pausing the internal review of his next paper. The peasants mistake this serenity for relaxation.

Culture

Joy, Carefully Peer-Reviewed

His delight is not easily earned. This pizza passed a ruthless evaluation of structure, originality, and impact. It still lost half a point for limited citation potential.
